column1: # The CLIs in the image: a name, then the command, tab-separated. The collector appends the protocol's arguments,
# and skips a CLI whose command is not in the image (the x86-64-v3 builds on arm64).
# x64 only: the JIT with AVX switched off dispatches as a default NativeAOT publish does, so against the JIT it is the cost of the
# lost tiers, and against default NativeAOT the cost of ahead-of-time code at the same tiers. On arm64 it is the JIT again.
# zxing-cpp's .NET package as shipped, and with its native library swapped for zxingcpp-default's commit and flags built as a
# shared library: against zxingcpp-default, the second is what the wrapper adds.
# The JVM sizes its GC from the container's CPUs and memory, so G1 and a fixed 1 GiB heap are set, as .NET's are in the image.
# The JVM CLIs also raise the run's warmup and batch length to their own floors (Protocol.java): BoofCV's image decode settled
# only after 8 to 9 s, and the JVM's per-call time swings by about 5 % from second to second.
